decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly building up a strong board presence of Elves to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful abilities. By using cards like Priest of Titania and Wirewood Symbiote to generate mana and bounce creatures for additional value, the deck can quickly ramp into powerful threats like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. Survival of the Fittest provides flexibility and consistency, allowing the player to search for key creatures while maintaining pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to create a fast and powerful board state to quickly overwhelm the opponent.

The main theme of the deck is centered around controlling the game through various spell cards and using the Oath of Druids ability to bring out powerful creatures such as Phantom Nishoba. The deck aims to disrupt opponent's strategies with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Swords to Plowshares while also maintaining card advantage with Sylvan Library. The inclusion of cards like Dust Bowl and Wasteland allows for land disruption to further control the game. Ultimately, the deck focuses on establishing dominance on the battlefield through control and efficient creature summoning.

The deck focuses on utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly cheat out powerful creatures from the deck, while controlling the game with various removal and disruption spells. It aims to establish board control with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Armageddon, while also gaining card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library and Scroll Rack. The deck also includes life gain and graveyard hate to withstand aggressive strategies. Overall, the key strategy is to control the board state, disrupt the opponent's plans, and quickly overwhelm them with powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cheat out Phyrexian Dreadnought, a powerful 12/12 creature, by using cards like Stifle to counter its "enters the battlefield" ability. By combining Dreadnought with cards like Fling, the deck aims to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent in a single turn. The deck also includes cards like Grim Lavamancer and Lightning Bolt for additional removal and burn damage, creating a versatile combo deck that can win games through explosive plays and strategic use of counterspells.

The deck revolves around quickly overwhelming your opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Skirk Prospector to quickly get your Goblins onto the battlefield, combined with Goblin Warchief to reduce their cost, you can flood the board with cheap and powerful creatures. With additional support cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Sharpshooter for added value and removal, this deck aims to apply constant pressure to your opponent and finish them off swiftly before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to search for key pieces, along with Goblin Warchief to reduce costs, the deck aims to flood the board with goblins and unleash powerful tribal synergies. Cards like Goblin King and Siege-Gang Commander provide additional boosts and removal options, while Gempalm Incinerator can clear the way for attacks. With a mix of creature aggression and disruption through land destruction, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo by playing a low-cost creature with a powerful ability and then stifling its drawback. It also includes various ways to protect the combo, disrupt opponent's strategies, and draw cards efficiently. The goal is to create a fast and resilient win condition that can catch opponents off guard and secure victory before they have a chance to respond effectively.

The central idea of this deck revolves around utilizing the "Tinker Fling" combo to quickly and efficiently defeat the opponent. The deck includes cards like Phyrexian Devourer and Altar of Dementia to generate a large amount of cards in the graveyard, while also employing artifacts like Jeweled Amulet and Chromatic Sphere to generate the necessary mana. This allows the player to use Tinker to search for powerful artifacts, such as Mind Stone or City of Brass, which can then be sacrificed for lethal damage using Fling. The deck also includes cards like Defense Grid and Tangle Wire to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect its own combo.

The main focus of this deck is to create a powerful synergy between Enchantress creatures and enchantments in order to generate card advantage and control the game. By consistently drawing cards with Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence, the player can quickly assemble a powerful board state with cards like Solitary Confinement and Parallax Wave. Utilizing cards like Wild Growth and Fertile Ground, the deck can ramp up mana production to cast powerful spells like Replenish and Sacred Mesa. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage and powerful enchantment-based combos.

This deck focuses on using fast and aggressive Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent and deal damage quickly. With a mix of powerful creatures like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander, along with support cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Goblin Ringleader, the deck aims to establish early board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland also disrupt the opponent's mana base, further increasing the deck's advantage. Overall, this deck aims to win through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive tactics.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, bounce spells, and resource denial. By utilizing cards like Powder Keg, Stifle, and Counterspell, as well as utilizing land-based removal like Dust Bowl and Quicksand, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's progress while generating card advantage with Fact or Fiction. The win condition is to beat down with land creatures like Faerie Conclave and Mishra's Factory, while maintaining control of the game with counterspells and bounce spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using powerful creature removal and disruption spells, such as Survival of the Fittest and Opposition. By utilizing cards like Winter Orb and Quirion Ranger, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's board development while building up its own resources. The inclusion of creatures like Mystic Snake and Tradewind Rider provide additional control options, while cards like Gilded Drake and Squee, Goblin Nabob offer versatility in dealing with threats. Overall, the deck looks to leverage its control elements to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath and Symbiotic Wurm, using cards like Putrid Imp and Careful Study. By using cards like Reanimate and Exhume, you can bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a quick and impactful combo. Additionally, cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal help generate the necessary mana to execute the combo efficiently. This reanimator strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats early in the game.

The key idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, using low-cost creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly. By utilizing efficient creatures like Mogg Fanatic and Jackal Pup alongside powerful direct damage spells like Fireblast and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to finish the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. Cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll provide additional reach for closing out games, while Grim Lavamancer helps to maintain pressure throughout the match. Overall, this deck prioritizes speed and consistent damage output to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using creatures with efficient abilities and strong threats to control the game. It emphasizes using cards like Blastoderm and Ravenous Baloth to apply pressure while using disruptive spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Recurring Nightmare allows for repeated value from creatures entering and leaving the battlefield. Pernicious Deed acts as a board wipe against various threats. The mana base provides a good balance of colors to support the deck's strategies.

This deck focuses on establishing board control through a combination of efficient creatures and removal spells. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress while also maintaining a strong board presence with creatures like Blastoderm and Ravenous Baloth. The inclusion of cards like Recurring Nightmare and Living Wish allows for flexible gameplay options and the ability to recur key creatures from the graveyard. Pernicious Deed serves as a versatile board wipe to deal with problematic threats. The deck aims to grind out the opponent and take over the game with its resilient threats and disruption.
